name: eai
description: Enterprise AI platform tenant resources — discover Object Types, then list, query, create, update, delete and run actions on records. Connects with an app identity (no user sign-in).

connection.instructions:
Connect with an **app identity** issued by the Enterprise AI platform team — no user sign-in is involved.

1. Ask the EAI platform owner for a client id and client secret that is allowed to access your tenant's resources.
2. Copy your **EAI tenant id** (shown in the EAI admin console, or via `eai whoami`).
3. Paste all three below.

fields.name: EAI_CLIENT_ID
fields.label: EAI client id
fields.helpText: Entra CIAM application (client) id issued for this connection.

fields.name: EAI_CLIENT_SECRET
fields.label: EAI client secret
fields.helpText: The client secret for the application above.

fields.name: EAI_TENANT_ID
fields.label: EAI tenant id
fields.helpText: The EAI tenant whose resources this connection reads and writes.
